gold.sql:
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(metric_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  SUM(new_users) AS value
FROM growth_daily_metrics
WHERE
  metric_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND metric_date < CAST('2026-08-29' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  1
SELECT user_id, registered_at FROM user_registrations WHERE registered_at >= DATE '1900-01-01' AND registered_at < DATE '1900-01-02' ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 20

execution_log.label: 新增用户数
execution_log.description: 按该渠道在2026年5月带来的注册用户数量排序
execution_log.question: 请问“表现最好”具体是指哪个指标最高？

arguments.sql:
SELECT
  ac.channel_name,
  COUNT(ur.registration_id) AS new_users
FROM askdata_ops.user_registrations ur
JOIN askdata_ops.acquisition_channels ac ON ur.channel_id = ac.channel_id
WHERE ur.registered_at >= '2026-05-01'::timestamp
  AND ur.registered_at < '2026-06-01'::timestamp
GROUP BY ac.channel_name
ORDER BY new_users DESC
LIMIT 1
